key_idea: The school is at the right end, so house A is the farthest and house E is the closest.
steps: From farthest to closest, the houses go A, B, C, D, E.
Exactly 2 friends live farther away than Leo. So Leo lives in C, and Nina and Omar live in A and B.
Eva and Pia live in D and E.
Eva lives farther away than Pia. D is farther than E, so Eva lives in D.

choice_feedback.A: A is Nina's or Omar's house. They live farther away than Leo.
choice_feedback.B: B is Nina's or Omar's house. They live farther away than Leo.
choice_feedback.C: C is Leo's house, because exactly 2 houses are farther away.
choice_feedback.E: E is the closest house. Eva lives farther away than Pia, so E is Pia's house.
